entries.anchor: Rules 1, 4 and 5 are REVIEW floors, not mode floors
entries.rationale: Validation run #2 (ai-dossier#770) forced bounded issues to full-cycle on rule 4 (deploy pipeline: imboard#4136, #3549) and rule 5 (>8 files: #4239, #4355), leaving a 2-member batch. Operator decision (#770, #818): both are review-depth questions, so they raise review=full under the <=2 cap; rule 8 stays a mode floor (no browser in the batch gate).
